text:
Iris K: FYI - onboarding run for orpheus-32k-int8 showed a reproducible token-slip around the 30k mark. sharing notes here.
Diego M: can you post the exact run command and flags?
Iris K: ran:
```
./harness_longctx --model orpheus-32k --quant int8-channelwise --ropescale rescale2 --prefill_stride 64 --capture-kv --kv-checksum 1024 --job orph-20260401-01
```
Iris K: minimal log snippet:
```
[2026-04-01T10:04:15Z] KV-TILE: tile=29 start=29696 len=1024 checksum=0xa1b2c3
[2026-04-01T10:04:15Z] KV-TILE_DEQ: tile=29 checksum=0xa1b2c3
[2026-04-01T10:04:15Z] KV-TILE: tile=30 checksum=0x5d6e7f
[2026-04-01T10:04:15Z] DIFF first-mismatch tile=30 offset=58 global-token=29754
[2026-04-01T10:04:15Z] INFER(INT8): token=29755 -> "clause" prob=0.68
[2026-04-01T10:04:15Z] INFER(FP16): token=29755 -> "clause." prob=0.92
```
Mia Nguyen: seeing pattern similar to other 32k bring-ups. did you try `--quant-scale-mode global` and `--rotary-interpolate true`?
Iris K: not yet. infra host shows no memcopy reorder patches. queuing a re-run with those flags (job orph-20260401-02).
Samir Patel: quick thought - is prefill stride aligned to shard tiling? if stride != tile size, we saw off-by-two in the past.
Iris K: prefill_stride=64, tile=1024. i toggled kv-align=true in a quick run, mismatch frequency reduced but still appears.
Diego M: try hybrid quant to localize: lower layers fp16, upper int8. if mismatch jumps earlier it's quant accumulation.
Iris K: ran hybrid (layers 0..14 fp16). mismatch onset moved earlier by ~96 tokens -> suggests cumulative quant rounding.
Mia Nguyen: run with global scale + rotary interpolate and also add rolling checksum per 512 tokens to narrow first mismatch.
Iris K: re-run queued, job orph-20260401-02 with `--quant-scale-mode global --rotary-interpolate true --kv-checksum 512`.
ci-bot: job orph-20260401-02 started, artifacts streaming to s3://redwood-ci/orph-20260401-02/
Iris K: quick result - checksum mismatch count dropped 5->0 across 6 runs. latency increased ~3.5%.
Samir Patel: good signal that per-shard scaling was amplifying rounding at tile boundaries. can you produce KL heatmap across 1k windows to confirm quality parity?
Iris K: running KL sweep overnight and will attach heatmap.
Mia Nguyen: add regression test to onboarding checklist: run sanitized legal prompt at 28k-31k window, require zero checksum mismatches on 10 runs.
Diego M: note tradeoff: hosted profile might prefer per-shard scaling for latency. recommend a canary on dedicated pool with global-scale to measure tail latency and error rate.
Iris K: filing ML-9572 to track canary + checklist update. attaching artifact links when CI completes. thanks all.
